item.title: "If it were conscious it would have tried to communicate"
item.description: Said the sentient spiders in Children of Time. They had a human locked in a cage. They’d never seen one before. The human seemed to just kind of sit there and move restlessly, but it made no attempts to communicate.
“the feminine archetype is evolving” This is the truth that Michael Levin & Blaise Aguera would like to make but the world isn’t anywhere near ready to understand this ...

item.title: Epistemic shortcuts are necessary, but some grow your awareness, & others shrink it
item.description: Peer review is an epistemic shortcut. If you are able to validate the truth of the paper yourself (like just test it/firsthand) you don’t need it. If you can’t, you trust someone or something to do it.

item.title: How Autistic Supercharmers Develop
item.description: How Autistic Supercharmers Develop (1 / 2) You find social interaction confusing, because the rules keep changing. Making a phone call to schedule an appointment is hard because you’re trying to answer: in what order do I need to give the information? Do I blurt it all out at first? Do I say hi and wait for them to ask? It seems there is NO correct answer.
